twin: the source print (womens-gym-lunges-and-lattes-cropped-hoodie, 3600 x 3981, a Sand print) had LUNGES & LATTES as one line of brown bubble lettering above the lunging-bunny art (rows 428-3981 kept, clean row gap); the line was cropped away and re-set beside the art as LUNGES / & / LATTES, since one long line could not reach 40% of the print. The bunny's black fur is part of the ink: on dark blanks the fur merges with the blank and the cream and pink linework carries the drawing.
h7: headline LUNGES 1341 px and & 237 px / punch LATTES 1485 px (111% of the headline)
inks_ash: brown headline, navy punch, cream keyline
inks_light: pink headline, cream punch, dark keyline
